Layout and content: Persistent sidebar, compact mobile nav, wedding switcher, breadcrumbs, global actions, profile menu
Interactions: Navigation, active state, collapse/expand, mobile drawer, route guards
Detailed behaviour: Use the module's required content as the page hierarchy; place primary action at the top-right on desktop and as a clear full-width action on mobile. Keep filters persistent and visible.

Layout and content: Login, registration, email verification, forgot/reset password, session expiry
Interactions: Form validation, password visibility, resend verification, recovery confirmation
Detailed behaviour: Use progressive authentication: invitation summary → exact invited email → account sign-in/register → email OTP → explicit accept. OTP supports paste, keyboard entry, resend timer and change-email only where policy permits.
